عششت (form I)
# عَشَشْتُ (ʕašaštu) /ʕa.ʃaʃ.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
# عَشَشْتَ (ʕašašta) /ʕa.ʃaʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
# عَشَشْتِ (ʕašašti) /ʕa.ʃaʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
# عُشِشْتُ (ʕušištu) /ʕu.ʃiʃ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
# عُشِشْتَ (ʕušišta) /ʕu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
